dialogues.en:
<$voicel(2,5)>To fix up the building, we’re gonna need lots of different
materials.
<$voicel(2,7)>You might have some luck finding what we need on the
islands in this town, <$voicel(2,10)>so I’d start by exploring those!

<$voicel(2,5)><$emotion(2,9)>If that doesn’t getcha everything you need, then your best
bet would be <$voicel(2,8)>headin’ back to other towns and seein’
what ya can find there!<$motion(2,652)>
<$voicel(2,9)><$emotion(2,1)>And hey, if you happen to bring some Pokémon willin’ to
help with <$cdef(27)>building, I won’t complain!

<$voicel(2,7)><$emotion(2,23)><$comeff(2,9)>Once we’ve got all the materials we need and a good crew
of Pokémon, we’ll be ready to start! <$voicel(2,10)><$comeff(2,10)>Just say the word!

<$voicel(1,9)><$emotion(1,22)><$motion(2,656)>Yes! And then this building’s restoration will
finally begin!
<$voicel(1,7)><$motion(1,655)><$comeff(1,9)>But you don’t need an oldster like me getting in your
way, so I’ll head back to the<$cdef(27)> Pokémon Center.

<$comeff(1,10)><$facial(1,4)><$motion(1,801)><$voicel(1,9)>I look forward to seeing this building completed,
<$cdef(27)> and <$cdef(27)>Tinkmaster!

<$comeff(1,9)><$facial(1,4)><$motion(1,806)><$voicel(1,9)>Will that huge building really regain its former glory? I’m
giddy just thinking about it!

<$comeff(1,3)><$motion(1,661)><$voicel(1,5)>You might need to return to other towns for materials
and helpers.

<$emotion(2,14)><$voicel(2,7)>We’re gonna fix up the <$cdef(27)>second floor first! Take a good
look at that<$cdef(27)> building kit, then go <$emotion(2,38)><$voicel(2,9)>find us the materials
and Pokémon we need!

<$emotion(2,1)><$voicel(2,9)>We’ve started <$cdef(27)>building the <$cdef(27)>second floor! Thanks for all the
hard work, <$cdef(27)>!

<$comeff(2,14)><$motion(2,661)><$voicel(2,5)>Now I’m pretty good at <$cdef(27)>building stuff, <$emotion(2,51)><$voicel(2,4)>but a project this
size might take a while.

<$emotion(2,60)><$voicel(2,9)>So yeah, you can chill out or explore... Do whatever ya
feel like doin’ till we’re done!
<$emotion(2,37)><$voicel(2,8)>Come talk to me once we’re finished!

You can check out the <$cdef(27)>building kit to see how much time is
left before construction is finished!
<$emotion(1,38)><$voicel(1,7)><$kfacial(1)>So you’ve finally begun rebuilding that building!

<$comeff(1,9)><$facial(1,4)><$motion(1,806)><$voicel(1,9)>We can leave the rest to <$cdef(27)>Tinkmaster and the others, so
let’s just wait in anticipation for the big finish!
<$comeff(1,3)><$facial(1,1)><$motion(1,661)><$voicel(1,8)>In the meantime, you might want to continue working on
the rest of this town.
<$emotion(2,38)><$voicel(2,9)>Just gotta wait a bit longer till the <$cdef(27)>second floor</color> is finished!

<$emotion(2,38)><$voicel(2,9)>For the <$cdef(27)>second floor, I put in a human workspace and a
Pokémon playspace!
<$comeff(2,9)><$facial(2,4)><$motion(2,806)><$voicel(2,7)>See, that way, when the humans come back, they can have
fun with us AND work at the same time!
<$emotion(2,14)><$voicel(2,6)>Next up, we gotta work on the <$cdef(27)>third floor</color>!
